question: How many days per week are hybrid employees expected to be in the office?
reference_answer: Most eligible hybrid employees are expected to attend their designated office an average of two days per week. Teams may set a higher requirement during peak trading periods, operational changes or major projects.

question: What are the core hours for remote employees?
reference_answer: Core hours are 10:00 to 15:00 local time, Monday to Friday. Customer and operational teams follow their team rota.

question: How do I request time off?
reference_answer: Submit the leave request in advance through PeopleHub, IronStore's HR system. Leave is only confirmed once your line manager approves it. Requests should be made at least 10 calendar days before leave of one to five working days and at least 20 calendar days before longer leave.

question: How much notice do I need to give for annual leave longer than five working days?
reference_answer: Requests for leave exceeding five working days must be submitted through PeopleHub at least 20 calendar days in advance.

question: How quickly should a manager respond to an annual leave request?
reference_answer: Managers should respond to annual leave requests within five working days.

question: What is the deadline for submitting an expense claim?
reference_answer: Expense claims must be submitted in SpendHub within 30 calendar days of the expense date. Month-end claims should be submitted by the third working day of the following month, and claims more than 90 days late need Finance approval.

question: What is the maximum I can claim for dinner on a business trip?
reference_answer: Dinner during approved business travel can be reimbursed up to €45.

question: What is the mileage reimbursement rate for using my own car?
reference_answer: Mileage is reimbursed at the applicable national rate published by Finance, currently €0.30 per business kilometre in countries using the standard IronStore rate. Normal commuting is excluded.

question: When do I need pre-approval for hotel accommodation?
reference_answer: Written pre-approval is required before booking accommodation expected to exceed €200 per night, excluding taxes.

question: What are the password requirements?
reference_answer: Passwords must be at least 14 characters long. MFA is mandatory for externally accessible systems and administrative access; systems that cannot support MFA must enforce a minimum 16-character password. Routine password changes are not required for standard accounts when MFA is enabled.

question: My company laptop was stolen. What should I do?
reference_answer: Report the lost or stolen device to the Service Desk within one hour of discovery. IT may remotely lock or wipe the device.

question: What is the standard domestic delivery time for in-stock products?
reference_answer: Standard domestic delivery is 2–4 working days after dispatch, with a dispatch target within one working day of payment approval.

question: Within how many days can customers return unopened products?
reference_answer: Unless a longer legal or commercial period applies, unopened and resalable goods are accepted within 30 calendar days of delivery. Personalised goods and opened sealed hygiene or beauty products are exceptions.

question: How long is a return authorisation (RMA) valid?
reference_answer: The RMA is valid for 14 calendar days unless a different period is shown in the case.

question: What commission rate applies to standard product categories?
reference_answer: Standard categories earn 1.0% of eligible net revenue (strategic or high-margin categories 1.25%, low-margin or clearance categories 0.50%).

history.content: What is our remote work policy?

question: Does it also apply to warehouse staff?
